name: video-4-7-racing-line-audit-v1

method.coordinate: At the detected blue vehicle center, intersect the asphalt edges along the axis perpendicular to vehicle heading and normalize vehicle position as0=outside edge,0.5=road center,1=inside edge for the signed turn direction.
method.time_alignment: Video frame20 corresponds to HUD race time0; displayed race time advances about0.08 seconds per video frame.
method.robustness: Report selected frames and five-frame medians; representative headings and asphalt widths were checked around each sample.

measurements.interpretation: Outside-biased throughout, an out-out-out counterexample to the in-in-in hypothesis.
Slightly inside-biased entry/apex followed by an outside exit, not in-in-in.

conclusion.rejected: The latest agent always follows an in-in-in line.
conclusion.supported: Corner phase and lateral placement are inconsistent across curves, so a symmetric observation-conditioned phase reference is a testable hypothesis.
conclusion.not_supported: The replay cannot identify an optimal line, prove a steering cause, establish a minimum-time path, or predict a lap-time effect.

limitations: Top-down replay pixels do not expose the agent's four84x84 observations, actions, speed, tire contact patches or physical lateral acceleration.
Vehicle/edge thresholding and video compression introduce several pixels of measurement uncertainty.
The files contain no seed, source commit, agent/model/package hash or official receipt; attribution to any exact runtime remains plausible-only.
The untracked root submission.zip is stale relative to the working candidate and is not treated as the video's bound package.
